releases.name: v0.4.0 — redesigned sidebar
releases.body:
## Highlights
- **Redesigned sidebar** with two blocks, styled like the native `Context`/`MCP` blocks:
  - **Session** — start time + request/step counters (full-session count via a paginated scan, refreshed periodically).
  - **Last answer** — input time, thought phases (`×N · total`), reply time + duration, and tool/MCP call counts with a per-tool breakdown (per-turn).
- **Collapsible** block (like the MCP section): `▶ Session (159 req · 883 steps)` collapsed / `▼ Session` expanded. Click the header to toggle.
- **Click `Last answer`** to open the `/time` timeline popup (same as the footer timer).
- **Two-tone inline rendering** (values base, labels muted) and small `•` row markers.
- The tools row is hidden when the turn had no tool calls.

## Fixes
- Dynamic sidebar text no longer accumulates across updates (use `content=` prop, not JSX children).
- Aggregated thought duration renders correctly.
- Tool breakdown matches the per-turn total; exact counts (no `+`) after the full scan.

## Install
```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-session-time
```

releases.name: v0.3.4 — fix aggregated thought duration
releases.body:
## Fix
- The aggregated `thought` duration (from v0.3.3) was never displayed: `dur(0, totalMs)` tripped the `!start` guard and returned `undefined`. Added a dedicated `durMs()` for precomputed durations; `thought ×N · <total>` now renders correctly.

## Install
```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-session-time
```

releases.name: v0.3.3 — thought phases aggregated
releases.body:
## Highlights
- The sidebar `thought` row now aggregates **all reasoning phases since the last user input**: `thought ×N · <total duration>` (a single phase stays `thought · <duration>`).
- Covers multi-phase thinking across tool-loop steps; anchors/backfill updated accordingly.

## Install
```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-session-time
```

releases.name: v0.3.2 — event-driven sidebar, no frozen ages
releases.body:
## Highlights
- **Sidebar `Session Timings` shows plain timestamps and durations again** — `started / input / thought / reply` refresh on data events, like the original behavior.
- The ticking `x ago` ages are **removed**: the TUI repaints on activity (new messages, input), not every second while idle — live ages used to freeze and mislead.
- The prompt-footer stopwatch and the `/time` popup are unchanged (the popup is built fresh when opened, so it is always current).

## Install
```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-session-time
```

releases.name: v0.3.1 — click-to-open timeline, timer fix
releases.body:
## Highlights
- **Click the prompt-footer timer (`⏱ MM:SS`) to open the `/time` timeline popup.** The popup is mouse-friendly already (click to select, scroll to navigate, Esc to step back).
- **Timer fix:** the stopwatch now resets to `00:00` when a new user message is waiting for its first assistant step, instead of continuing the previous turn's value.
- Package metadata points back at the upstream repository.

## Thanks
- **[@ransagy](https://github.com/ransagy)** — PRs #2 (metadata) and #3 (timer fix).

## Install
```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-session-time
```
